author: MTINC
body:
Before you start reading this, be warned: I am not complaining. I am simply commenting and suggesting on this matter. I hope I have made myself clear.

Now back to business. Avicus is very unique; as there are many different games that are very fun and engaging. However, I was scoping some other servers out and found one called Overcast network. I logged in and found that many of their games are similar to the ones found on avicus, for example the objective on one was to destroy the wools before the other team, similar to destroy the obsid on avicus, or team deathmatches, again found here on avicus. I found it interesting to know that on average the overcast network has 600 players, and on average avicus has 100-200 players.

I told my friend about avicus and he said that he already knew about avicus, suggesting that avicus server is well known, as he did not talk to me about avicus beforehand.
My big question comes down to this:
Why are there roughly 600 the players on overcast and only 200 on avicus? I ask this because many of the games on overcast are similar to the ones found on avicus. Everyone in the avicus community wants the server to grow, but how can it when there are more players on another server that most of the same content as ours?                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     Thank you for taking the time to read. Greatly appreciated!

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
Overcast actually has maybe 900 players averagely. You must have joined in the off-peak times (school time). 

Of course one could argue that Avicus copies Overcast, and how come Avicus is so silimar. Though as stated before, Avicus was based of Overcast. 

Though I do notice a lot of differences. For example, Overcast has more game modes (objective wise). Avicus has DTM (Destroy the Monument) and Deathmatch, while Overcast has DTM, DTC, CTW, Death match (TDM), KoTH, and so forth. So one could also argue that Avicus's main idea is similar, but a lot is different if you actually look at the servers.

Another example is Avicus has a shop in game that you can buy with points from kills. Overcast does not have this.

The game play is also different between the two servers.

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
Please refrain from bumping old topics, especially if your reply does not relate or further the discussion.

And, please stay on topic  ^-^

I think that many servers are the same simply because one server will not satisfy everyone's needs, even if its games are creative and well-thought out. Even little tweaks to a game between servers may change someone's opinion on the game and server. The community of a server also changes depending on the amount and "quality" of the people there. Generally, a smaller server would have a more mature community but less diversity, and vice versa for bigger servers.

Personally I find Avicus to have just the right amount of players in the community for it to be enjoyable for me, and I find the games on this server very appealing and addictive. This is probably the reason why I'm still playing on this server and, more importantly, having fun doing it!
